draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for the note — glad things are going well so far, and happy to take you up on that walkthrough whenever it suits.

Since our onboarding call, the one thing worth doing next is getting a first project started: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and it works best with real work rather than a placeholder.

Would a short call this week work? I can walk through setting up that first project with you live.

Best,
Priya
